name: Испытательный центр
approval_context: The 2026-10-31 same-style correction restores E2 to the canonical HD pixel-art/pixel-look family while preserving its previously approved engineering content. Exact-SHA visual self-review and E0→E1→E2 blind-order review passed. The new matrix is the immutable raw imagegen original; role-specific elements/applications files are explicitly recorded as derived review views from that same raw source.

authority.note: Generated lettering/pseudo-text inside reference sheets is non-authoritative; use the imagery for era language only.

preserved: industrial serviceability, standardized safety language and visible technical infrastructure
physical electromechanical construction with readable maintenance access
replaced: E1 workshop-centric cabinets and early electronics with denser rack-based test/diagnostic systems
primarily hydraulic/electromotor emphasis with motorized servo and motor-reducer systems
mixed industrial panels with a stronger beige/gray technical-plastic and aluminium laboratory language
basic organized trays with more explicit routed harnesses, connectors and diagnostic cabling
added: CRT-dominant operator and diagnostic stations in deep/bulky housings
electronic racks, ventilation grilles, modular diagnostic/service bays and replaceable electronics
denser grouped early LED indication and test instrumentation
specialized test-center buildings, measurement posts and service modules
transition_from_e1.why: The base has matured from a standardized workshop into a dedicated aerospace test center where diagnostics, instrumentation and motorized control are first-class infrastructure.
transition_from_e1.player_signal: More electronics and racks, deeper CRT stations, dense routed cabling, specialized test/diagnostic buildings and visibly motorized equipment; E2 is intentionally more technically busy than cleaner E3.

era_gate_review.engineering_distinctness: pass: E2 remains materially different from E1 across manufacturing, materials, drive, interface, lighting, infrastructure and silhouette/architecture
era_gate_review.monitor_review: pass: CRTs are visibly deep/bulky and diagnostic/rack-oriented; no flat-display E3 shorthand dominates
era_gate_review.style_family_review: pass: correction uses deliberate pixel clusters, stepped shading, selective chromatic outlines and the same dark-panel reference-sheet language as E0/E1
era_gate_review.blind_order_result: pass: without year labels the sequence reads E0 hand-built/repairable → E1 standardized industrial workshop → E2 specialized electromechanical test/diagnostic center

usage.reference_strategy: Use the corrected E2 matrix as the canonical style/engineering source together with approved E1 and E0 sets, the era matrix and asset-specific brief. The derived elements/applications views are role-specific review aids from the same exact raw source. Legacy E2 sheets may be consulted only for engineering-content history, not canonical style.
usage.system_separation: Physical hardware/materials belong in art; active screen data, glow, motion, sparks, fields and temporary FX remain code-owned unless explicitly scoped otherwise.
